cycles_note: card cycles are nominal ARM946E-S figures (1 = one core cycle at 67 MHz); memory wait states are the machine's

flag_codes.S: computed when the S bit is set

instruction_locals_note: set and read inside one instruction only (the barrel shifter's carry): lifted blocks keep it in a local
name: armv5te
sources: ARM946E-S and ARM7TDMI Technical Reference Manuals
statement: ARMv5TE (the Nintendo DS ARM9, an ARM946E-S) and ARMv4T (the DS ARM7, an ARM7TDMI): 32-bit ARM and 16-bit Thumb instruction sets, sixteen registers with banked copies per mode, CPSR with N Z C V Q I F T and the mode. One card per instruction form (registry isa, pack armv5te); cards marked arch v5te are undefined at arch 4.
